usage: propose.py [-h] --request REQUEST --response RESPONSE [--device DEVICE]
                  [--benchmark {alfworld,appworld,terminalbench2,swebench_pro,hotpotqa,webshop,lawbench}]
                  [--env-config ENV_CONFIG] [--final-evaluation]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --request REQUEST
  --response RESPONSE
  --device DEVICE       Legacy requests only; must match resolved config if
                        supplied
  --benchmark {alfworld,appworld,terminalbench2,swebench_pro,hotpotqa,webshop,lawbench}
  --env-config ENV_CONFIG
  --final-evaluation    Held-out evaluation only, never training or search

usage: entrypoint.py [-h] --request REQUEST --response RESPONSE
                     [--device DEVICE]
                     [--benchmark {alfworld,appworld,terminalbench2,swebench_pro,hotpotqa,webshop,lawbench}]
                     [--env-config ENV_CONFIG] [--final-evaluation]
                     {propose,check_internalization,evaluate,train}

positional arguments:
  {propose,check_internalization,evaluate,train}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --request REQUEST
  --response RESPONSE
  --device DEVICE       Legacy requests only; must match resolved config if
                        supplied
  --benchmark {alfworld,appworld,terminalbench2,swebench_pro,hotpotqa,webshop,lawbench}
  --env-config ENV_CONFIG
  --final-evaluation    Held-out evaluation only, never training or search

usage: hi run [-h] --manifest MANIFEST --backend BACKEND
              [--experiment-config EXPERIMENT_CONFIG] [--run-seed RUN_SEED]
              [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT] --output OUTPUT
              [--planned-update-batches TRAIN_STEPS] [--cycles CYCLES]
              [--harness-workspace HARNESS_WORKSPACE | --harness-revision HARNESS_REVISION | --state STATE]
              [--protocol PROTOCOL] [--revision-store REVISION_STORE]
              [--attribution-policy ATTRIBUTION_POLICY]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --backend BACKEND
  --experiment-config EXPERIMENT_CONFIG
                        Strict execution settings; replace backend execution
                        settings
  --run-seed RUN_SEED   Override run and model sampling seeds together
                        (17/29/43)
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
                        Required for a fresh run; optional check when resuming
                        --state
  --output OUTPUT
  --planned-update-batches TRAIN_STEPS, --train-steps TRAIN_STEPS
                        Total planned update batches (not optimizer steps);
                        default 300, or resumed protocol
  --cycles CYCLES       Total planned cycles; default 3, or preserved from
                        resumed protocol
  --harness-workspace HARNESS_WORKSPACE
                        Import a configured executable Harness source tree
  --harness-revision HARNESS_REVISION
                        JSON HarnessRevision or accepted state/deployment
  --state STATE         Continue from an accepted checkpoint/Harness/protocol
                        pair
  --protocol PROTOCOL   Protocol sidecar for a relocated historical state
  --revision-store REVISION_STORE
  --attribution-policy ATTRIBUTION_POLICY
                        Fixed pre-training gate JSON; defaults to 95% task
                        bootstrap, lower gain > 0
